## DSH Lite Exec v0.1.5

Plugin for **DeepSeek Harness (DSH)** providing four bounded shell and file inspection tools, now registered by default on installation:

| Tool | Summary |
| --- | --- |
| `lite_exec` | Bounded shell execution with automatic spill files (`16 KiB` default preview, up to `16 MiB` per spill slot). Defaults to PowerShell under restricted Windows sessions and Git Bash under full access / POSIX platforms. |
| `lite_read` | Byte-window reader for large files, spill logs, and Electron ASAR entries. Supports `auto`, UTF-8, UTF-16LE/BE, GBK/CP936, binary hex preview (up to 512 B), and `ENOENT` filename suggestions. |
| `lite_grep` | Literal line search across files and explicit ASAR paths with up to 32 `include` globs, `ignoreCase`, bounded previews, and JSONL spill overflow (up to 5,000 matches). |
| `lite_stat` | Existence, size, modification time, and ASAR container metadata inspection. |

### Highlights in `0.1.5`
- **Tools enabled by default**: Removed the default `enabled: false` override in bundled `cordis.patch.yml` so all four tools register automatically upon installation. Explicit `config.enabled: false` or `config.tools: []` overrides still disable registration and now log the reason on startup, alongside stricter validation for `enabled` and `tools`.
- **Consistent GBK & encoding detection in `lite_grep`**: Aligned `lite_grep` line scanning with `lite_read`'s `decodeWindow` encoding detection so detected GBK files remain consistent across lines and byte windows while preserving GBK fallback after ASCII prefixes.
- **Complete spill directory exclusion in `lite_grep`**: Excluded both global (`$DSH_HOME/dsh-lite-exec/spill`) and workspace (`.dsh-lite-exec/spill`) spill directories (including canonical paths) from `lite_grep` searches while keeping spill logs readable via `lite_read`.
- **Small-block ASAR integrity verification**: Added support for ASAR `SHA256` integrity blocks smaller than 64 KiB (such as 4 KiB blocks) across byte-range reads and greps.
- **Interrupted spill slot reuse recovery**: Added cleanup for expired abandoned `.pending-<pid>` files left behind by exited writers during slot reuse without affecting active writers or valid published logs.
- **Bundled verification scripts & updated docs**: Included `scripts/review-test.mjs`, `scripts/smoke.mjs`, and `scripts/spill-check.mjs` in the published package, clarified literal-search semantics on `lite_grep.pattern`, and updated installation and verification instructions.

### Installation & Verification
1. Quit DSH Desktop and install the release tarball (also published on npm as [`dsh-lite-exec`](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-lite-exec)):
   ```powershell
   $archive = (Resolve-Path -LiteralPath './dsh-lite-exec-0.1.5.tgz').Path
   dsh plugin --profile desktop add "dsh-lite-exec@file:$archive" --ignore-scripts
   ```
   Keep the tarball at that path because the Desktop profile records it as a file dependency.
2. Reopen DSH Desktop and start a new session. In a PTC session, verify registration via `run_code`:
   ```js
   console.log(await tools.lite_stat({ path: "." }))
   ```
   If tools are missing after upgrading from an earlier release, verify the Desktop plugin switch and check that `cordis.patch.yml` does not retain an old `config.enabled: false` or `config.tools: []` override.

Requires Node.js `>=24` and DSH `>=0.2.2-rc.3 <1.0.0`. See [README.md](https://github.com/ClearMind-17/lite-exec/blob/main/README.md) and [README.zh.md](https://github.com/ClearMind-17/lite-exec/blob/main/README.zh.md) for full documentation.
